scope: fixed raw inputs only; no scene query or ray generation in timed/profiled postprocessing
gpu_shared: desktop/review may share the device; no clocks or host settings changed
nonadditive: unsynchronized formal profile, annotated profile, synchronized sub-block probes and graph replay are separate experiments; do not add their medians

input.pose_policy: same make_poses default seed/prefix/full RPY as warp_ray_perf; target 3m forward

geometry.batch_geometry_policy: one static mesh BVH and shared analytic spheres; independent of ray count
geometry.input: world origins/directions float32 CUDA N3; radial max distance scalar or CUDA N
geometry.output: owned CUDA radial distance, object/triangle index and world hit point
geometry.near_clip_policy: none; nearest nonnegative surface before measurement validity
geometry.selection_policy: full scene or one analytic sphere; static mesh selection unsupported

decomposed_parity.comparison: exact all tensor fields; matching NaN/Inf classes and scene metadata
decomposed_parity.host_reads: verification only, outside every measured block

formal_warm.event_scope: complete stream span including CPU submission gaps; not kernel sum

profiler_prime: one discarded formal invocation initializes CUPTI/activity buffers before recorded profiles; not included in formal warm timings

formal_profiler.scope: profiler diagnostic, no intra-function barriers; profiler overhead excluded from warm wall measurements
formal_profiler.raw_duration_scope: sum of Chrome trace cat=kernel durations; excludes launch gaps/runtime/memcpy and may overlap on multiple streams

raw_device_events.name: profiled_postprocess
